headline: Starbucks Taps Advisers to Explore Sale of Japan Business
summary: Starbucks has engaged financial advisers, including Citigroup and Morgan Stanley, to evaluate a potential sale of its Japan business for several billion dollars.
why: Divestments of major regional operations by multinational corporations restructure capital allocation and core geographical focus.

impacts.name: Starbucks
impacts.why: Exploring the sale of a multi-billion dollar operating unit impacts corporate valuation and asset allocation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The potential multibillion-dollar monetization of a core foreign unit alters expectations of future corporate capital returns.
